title: Add priority to tasks
description: Update the local TaskBoard fixture so the function signature becomes createTask(title, priority = 'medium') and the returned task object contains the priority property.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Use the positional signature createTask(title, priority = 'medium'); do not introduce an options object.
The priority argument accepts the exact lowercase values low, medium, or high.
Priority defaults to medium when the second argument is omitted.
createTask throws an error containing 'invalid priority' for any other value.
Existing title validation and status=open behavior remain unchanged.

technicalContext: This is a local JavaScript teaching fixture, not a database-backed API.
The task factory is implemented in src/task.js.
The public API is intentionally positional for this small teaching fixture: createTask(title, priority).
Its tests are in test/task.test.js and run with node --test.
No persistence migration or backward data update is required.
